regime: Oil shock, with a tech-led relief bounce
takeaway: Brent eased slightly but settled near $116, so the oil-driven inflation worry behind last week's moves is still in place. Stocks bounced on Monday, led by chip and AI names, and the VIX fell about 5%, while gold held just above $4,000 and yields barely moved. The Fed decides Wednesday and the Bank of Japan on Friday, and either can change this picture quickly.
